newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Giordano down 29.7 pct after resumption.
newsitem.headline: Giordano down 29.7 pct after resumption.

text.p: Shares of Giordano International Ltd resumed trading down HK$1.50 or 29.70 percent at HK$3.55 in early trade on Monday after the company issued a statement clarifying its China operation.
Trading in Giordano shares, which had been suspended since January 17, resumed on Monday.

The clothing retailer said earlier on Monday that it was continuing to address regulatory procedural demands concerning its operations in China and was seeking investors to raise its profile there and in other markets.
The company said negotiations relating to the setting up of new Giordano retail outlets in Beijing and Shanghai had not been concluded.
Brokers said investors who bought the shares because of its China retail concept unloaded their stake after they saw some uncertainty over the company's China operations.
"The theme for the stock was its China expansion plans," said Kent Rossister, senior manager at Nikko Securities.
A sales manager at a regional brokerage said fear that the company's future earnings may be hit if the talks failed triggered the sell off.
